hooks.command: mkdir -p /tmp/claude-hooks; json=$(cat); id=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .session_id); ntype=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .notification_type); echo "$(date +%s) Notification:${ntype}" >> /tmp/claude-hooks/${id}.log

mkdir -p /tmp/claude-hooks; json=$(cat); id=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .session_id); tool=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .tool_name); echo "$(date +%s) PermissionRequest:${tool}" >> /tmp/claude-hooks/${id}.log

mkdir -p /tmp/claude-hooks; json=$(cat); id=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .session_id); tool=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .tool_name); echo "$(date +%s) PreToolUse:${tool}" >> /tmp/claude-hooks/${id}.log

mkdir -p /tmp/claude-hooks; json=$(cat); id=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .session_id); tool=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .tool_name); echo "$(date +%s) PostToolUse:${tool}" >> /tmp/claude-hooks/${id}.log

mkdir -p /tmp/claude-hooks; json=$(cat); id=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r .session_id); reason=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r '.stop_hook_reason // "end"'); f=/tmp/claude-hooks/${id}.log; echo "$(date +%s) Stop:${reason}" >> $f; tail -20 $f > $f.tmp && mv $f.tmp $f
